WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS manager_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
shares AS (
    SELECT throws, manager_count,
           1.0 * manager_count / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT throws, manager_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(manager_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing throwing hand is grouped as SQL NULL, and AVG over hands gives each distinct hand group, including NULL, equal weight.
